source_facts.name: serial_bottom

source_facts.name: serial_right
source_facts.finding: The serial right side is a UV-square trace borrowing its live analytic curve.

source_facts.name: serial_top
source_facts.finding: The serial top side is a UV-square trace borrowing its live analytic curve.

source_facts.name: serial_left
source_facts.finding: The serial left side is a UV-square trace borrowing its live analytic curve.

source_facts.name: serial_old_uv
source_facts.finding: Old-face geometry comes from triangle UV parameters; synthetic fixture seeds are a narrower contract.

source_facts.name: serial_old_size
source_facts.finding: Existing area/curvature-derived sizing feeds subdivision; it is not a free coverage parameter.

source_facts.name: serial_execute
source_facts.finding: The caller uses the native front execute path and preserves generation failure.

source_facts.name: native_prefix
source_facts.finding: Prefix generation must complete before geometry.

source_facts.name: prefix_initial_front
source_facts.finding: The native prefix establishes front/IDs before geometry.

source_facts.name: native_geometry_entry
source_facts.finding: Public geometry runs after the original prefix, without standalone-tree uniform refinement.

source_facts.name: small_front
source_facts.finding: A short front returns without selection.

source_facts.name: three_edge_shortcut
source_facts.finding: The exact-three shortcut publishes a Face without findBestVertex.

source_facts.name: first_pass
source_facts.finding: A larger admitted front enters the geometry front pass.

source_facts.name: second_pass
source_facts.finding: The rejected-edge pass runs only after geometry-done from the first pass; empty entry is not selection coverage.

source_facts.name: geometry_default
source_facts.finding: Both unqualified makeMesh calls use the geometryPhase default.

source_facts.name: boundary_front
source_facts.finding: The initial front starts with native boundary edges.

source_facts.name: template_front
source_facts.finding: The initial front additionally receives template-front edges.

source_facts.name: candidate_view
source_facts.finding: Each pass rebuilds its initial candidate view from front V1 pointers, not every owned vertex.

source_facts.name: native_selector
source_facts.finding: A non-marker edge invokes the inherited selector before caller domain classification.

source_facts.name: null_result
source_facts.finding: Null best follows queue rejection and cannot enter ideal retirement.

source_facts.name: normal
source_facts.finding: Ideal construction begins with the directed edge left normal.

source_facts.name: height
source_facts.finding: The offset and candidate-search radius use the attached cell height.

source_facts.name: offset
source_facts.finding: For a finite nondegenerate edge, ideal I equals native midpoint M plus cell height h times left unit normal N.

source_facts.name: degenerate_normal
source_facts.finding: Coincident endpoints yield zero normal; they are outside the nondegenerate caller prerequisites.

source_facts.name: general_left_normal
source_facts.finding: The general branch rotates the directed chord counterclockwise before normalization.

source_facts.name: normal_normalization
source_facts.finding: Finite nonzero norm is required for the unit-normal interpretation.

source_facts.name: arithmetic_midpoint
source_facts.finding: Generic edges cache the UV chord midpoint.

source_facts.name: curve_midpoint
source_facts.finding: Boundary edges may cache a curve-parametric midpoint instead of the arithmetic chord midpoint.

source_facts.name: boundary_midpoint_call
source_facts.finding: Native boundary append computes its oriented curve midpoint.

source_facts.name: initial_radius
source_facts.finding: The selector initializes the scale to one before makeIdealVertex multiplies by cell height.

source_facts.name: pending_ideal
source_facts.finding: A separate owner holds the fresh ideal while best is initially its observer.

source_facts.name: candidate_identity
source_facts.finding: Endpoint identity and exact coordinate matches are skipped before geometric filters.

source_facts.name: candidate_box
source_facts.finding: Candidates outside the ideal-centered axis box are skipped.

source_facts.name: candidate_radius
source_facts.finding: Candidates beyond the closed Euclidean radius are skipped.

source_facts.name: candidate_distance
source_facts.finding: Only candidates surviving both spatial filters undergo the base-edge distance aborts.

source_facts.name: negative_distance_abort
source_facts.finding: The literal negative-distance branch aborts; it is not an active signed-normal test for finite nondegenerate arithmetic.

source_facts.name: close_candidate_abort
source_facts.finding: A close candidate aborts the entire scan with null best, even if earlier candidates were accepted.

source_facts.name: topology_only_normal
source_facts.finding: The explicit accordingToNormal filter belongs to the non-geometry else branch.

source_facts.name: candidate_interception
source_facts.anchor: bool intercept = interceptionTest(e, candidate, true, false);
source_facts.finding: A candidate survives only if all-edge and live-front point/Face interception checks return false.

source_facts.name: candidate_publication
source_facts.finding: Any surviving candidate makes the completed list nonempty and selects the borrowed path.

source_facts.name: fresh_branch
source_facts.finding: A fresh ideal can be selected only after the full candidate scan returns normally with an empty survivor list.

source_facts.name: ideal_interception
source_facts.finding: The fresh ideal must also pass default all-edge and point/Face interception.

source_facts.name: ideal_proximity
source_facts.finding: The ideal must avoid native point-to-edge proximity on every edge in the edges view.

source_facts.name: ideal_adoption
source_facts.finding: Successful publication adopts the new ideal before returning existed=false; all publications must complete.

source_facts.name: borrowed_branch
source_facts.finding: A nonempty survivor list retires the pending temporary and selects an existing vertex.

source_facts.name: fresh_return
source_facts.finding: The successful fresh geometry branch returns existed=false; this alone does not imply outside-root coordinates.

source_facts.name: all_edges
source_facts.finding: The active onlyFrontEdges=false path checks all edges in the front observer view, not only the currently queued edges.

source_facts.name: two_candidate_segments
source_facts.finding: Both proposed triangle sides are checked against the existing edge view.

source_facts.name: live_front_point
source_facts.anchor: for (VertexList::iterator iter = frontVertices.begin(); iter != frontVertices.end(); iter++) {
source_facts.finding: The additional triangle-containment check visits the live front-vertex view.

source_facts.name: face_point_veto
source_facts.finding: A nonmatching live front vertex not outside the tentative triangle vetoes the candidate.

source_facts.name: proper_intersection
source_facts.finding: The segment predicate uses strict cross-product signs: endpoint/collinear contact is not a proper crossing.

source_facts.name: point_proximity
source_facts.finding: Point-to-edge veto uses a strict native distance threshold; equality is not below it.

source_facts.name: distance_unsigned
source_facts.finding: The active straightDistance is unsigned because Vertex::surface takes absolute area.

source_facts.name: absolute_area
source_facts.finding: Finite triangle surface is nonnegative; dist<0 is not a half-plane classifier.

source_facts.name: exact_match
source_facts.finding: The candidate-match filter uses exact coordinates, not tolerance-based equals.

source_facts.name: face_out
source_facts.finding: Face::out uses barycentric tolerance; !out includes the tolerated triangle boundary.

source_facts.name: barycentric_denominator
source_facts.finding: Nondegenerate triangle arithmetic is a prerequisite for the geometric interpretation of the point/Face veto.

source_facts.name: root_delegate
source_facts.finding: The caller tests the root, not the selected edge cell or physical patch contour.

source_facts.name: strict_interior
source_facts.anchor:
return (v->getX() > min->getX() && v->getX() < max->getX() &&
          v->getY() > min->getY() && v->getY() < max->getY());
source_facts.finding: For finite points !in includes root boundary and exterior; it is not synonymous with tolerance-expanded out.

source_facts.name: expanded_out
source_facts.finding: The out predicate expands the root by tolerance and must not replace the original !in guard.

source_facts.name: root_box
source_facts.finding: A complete normal UV-square boundary yields a fresh unit-square root.

source_facts.name: cell_height
source_facts.finding: The native ideal offset uses cell size; no edge-length/equilateral factor is introduced.

source_facts.name: cell_size
source_facts.finding: A coherent dyadic cell size is its maximum box span.

source_facts.name: midpoint_cell_lookup
source_facts.finding: Boundary/generated edge lookup uses the cached midpoint and expanded out test.

source_facts.name: template_front_cell
source_facts.finding: A template-side edge can use the coarser incident cell; its offset cannot be inferred from the edge chord alone.

source_facts.name: new_edge_cell
source_facts.finding: A generated edge receives native midpoint-based cell registration before later selection.

source_facts.name: domain_guard
source_facts.finding: After nonnull selector return, retirement additionally requires geometryPhase, a new selection and failure of strict root interior.

source_facts.name: retirement_queue
source_facts.finding: The caller republishes the edge before removing/deleting the adopted ideal.

source_facts.name: retirement_removal
source_facts.finding: Retirement removes all three observations/ownership entries before deleting; pending-owner cleanup is a different phase.

source_facts.name: fixture_cut
source_facts.finding: The qualified tracked fixture cuts before native selection; this source audit does not expand that fixture.
